notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Just a small update nothing too cool


 Added a volume slider to the main menu
 Fixed the leaderboard going off the screen
 Fixed a random crash connected to not connecting with Steam correctly

notes.title: Game Launch & First Update
notes.notes:
So we're here....

THE GAME ACTUALLY LAUNCHED! THAT'S AMAZING!

Steam says that people average about 6 minutes of play time which is wayyyyy more than anyone thought possible!

So continuing with the theme of me not knowing what I'm doing, I'm commemorating my first ever launch with my first ever game update. Wednesday, the 5th, I will push out a patch introducing a number of groovy changes such as:


 A volume slider as requested by popular demand!
 A new boss - The Lattice...inspired by the E8 Theory of Everything! Details to follow
 Various balance changes!
 New Achievements!
 A mind-bending secret no one will see coming! Stay Tuned!


Thanks again for everyone supporting this crazy endeavor. I'm hoping that I can parlay this experience into something even grander. I have a real passion for creation and I hope I get a chance to share some of my more insane ideas with the world! 

REFQSE5F

-Tobias
